test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will the difference be, of the average points scored by C and D?
solution:
Formula used: 

Average scored by a player in 4 games = Sum of the points scored/4 

Calculation:

Average points scored by player C in 4 games = 8 + 11 + 4 + 3 = 26/4 = 6.5

Average points scored by player D in 4 games = 10 + 12 + 2 + 8 = 32/4 = 8

∴ The difference of the average points scored by D and C = 8 - 6.5 

⇒ 1.5
